description.p: JSTS Pad is a lightweight standalone source editor for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and TSX.

It focuses on editing rather than execution: language-aware highlighting, code-oriented editing, editable templates, a searchable insertion Library, conservative source checks and explicit document-type handling, without Node, npm, an embedded runtime, debugger, language server or project system.
Corrects the source-root public README filename and packaging contract to README.md; application behavior is unchanged from 0.1.2.
Editor EOF scrolling corrective: disable global center-on-scroll so EOF stays naturally near the bottom while explicit Go To Line centering remains.
Publication and packaging-contract release adding the locked public README at source root; editor behavior is unchanged.
Packaging-focused release adopting the canonical Suite Pythoine portable/AppImage contract and the Friendly. Fast. Focused. Pad-family slogan, with editor behavior unchanged.
Initial experimental source release with JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and TSX profiles, Sheepy-derived code editing, Timblee-derived startup/templates/Library workflow, and no source execution.
